abstract: A 35-year-old man with an intra-abdominal testicular tumor arising from the right unresolved intraabdominal testis is reported. At 10 years old, left orchidopexy was successfully performed for bilateral undescended testes. However, the right testis was not detected during the operation, and it was diagnosed as vanishing testis. Twenty-five years later, he was referred to our hospital with the complaint of right lower abdominal pain. Computed tomography revealed huge pelvic tumors and bulky para-aortic lymph node swellings. Histopathologic examination of the needle biopsy specimen obtained from the pelvic tumor revealed seminomatous germ cell tumor. Taking the results with a tumor marker study into consideration, the patient was tentatively diagnosed with non-seminomatous germ cell tumor NSGCT (stage IIB) arising from the unresolved intra-abdominal testis or extragonadal germ cell tumor. He received 3 courses of bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin (BEP), and 4 courses of VP-16, ifosfamide, cisplatin (VIP). After chemotherapy, we performed tumorectomy and retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy because tumor markers were normalized and 2-[18F] fluoro-2-deoxy-D-glucose positron emission tomography (FDG-PET)-CT revealed normalization. We identified the pelvic tumor as an intra-abdominal testicular tumor arising from right unresolved intra-abdominal testis. Pathological examination revealed no residual tumor cells. There has been no recurrence 17 months after surgery.
abstract_ja: 35歳男性が、腹腔内の右精巣から生じた精巣腫瘍を呈した。10歳時に両側停留精巣に対して左精巣固定術が成功裏に行われたが、手術中に右精巣は確認されず、精巣消失と診断された。25年後、右下腹部痛を主訴に当院を紹介された。CTで巨大な骨盤内腫瘍と大きな腹部大動脈傍リンパ節腫大が認められた。骨盤内腫瘍からの針生検標本の病理組織学的検査で、セミノーマ成分を伴う胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。腫瘍マーカーの結果も考慮し、右の未下降腹腔内精巣に由来する非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(NSGCT、病期IIB)、または性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と暫定的に診断された。ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン(BEP)療法を3コース、VP-16、イホスファミド、シスプラチン(VIP)療法を4コース施行した。化学療法後、腫瘍マーカーが正常化し、FDG-PET-CTで集積の正常化が確認されたため、腫瘍摘除と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した。病理学的検査で残存腫瘍細胞は認められなかった。術後17か月の時点で再発は認められていない。
